description: This file defines a sealed interface 'Result' with implementations for Success, Error, and Loading states, along with an extension function 'asResult' that converts a Flow of type T into a Flow of Result<T> wrappers.

classes.name: Result
classes.description: A sealed interface representing the outcome of an operation, with concrete data classes for success, error, and loading states.

methods.name: asResult
methods.description: An extension function that converts a Flow of type T into a Flow of Result<T> by wrapping emitted items into Result.Success and handling loading and errors.
